current_grouping: Subpart D — UA Design and Construction

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart D — UAV Design and Construction
versions.text:
(a) The methods of fabrication used must produce consistently sound structures. If a fabrication process (such as glueing, spot welding, or heat-treating) requires close control to reach this objective, the process must be performed under an approved process specification.
(b) Each new UAV System fabrication method must be substantiated by a test programme.
